title: The 2017 event GW170817 was a neutron star merger seen in both ways.
purpose: Provide a concrete example of multi-messenger detection.
narration: In 2017, astronomers detected GW170817, a neutron star merger. This event was special because it was observed by both gravitational wave detectors and traditional telescopes. This multi-messenger observation confirmed the origin of short gamma-ray bursts and taught us about heavy element formation. For the first time, scientists saw both the gravitational ripples and the light from a cosmic collision, launching the era of multi-messenger astronomy.
